title: DG NETWORK
description: DG Network is a Minecraft server where players compete, grind, and improve their skills to become the best. You can earn resources, unlock powerful items, and battle other players while progressing through the server.
body: **DG Network** is one of **India’s leading Minecraft server** communities, offering a competitive and fun survival experience for players. Founded by Anubhav Kumar (DIMLgaminG), the server launched in **June 2022** and quickly grew into a large community. Players can grind, build, and battle others while enjoying a stable, lag-free environment with active staff and regular updates. Whether you enjoy **survival**, **PvP**, or playing with friends, DG Network provides a welcoming place for all Minecraft players to explore and compete.
